rows.grounds: present participle describing the act of drinking
adjective qualifying the stream as consisting of blood
object denoting the flow being drunk
compound adjective indicating the source of the stream; nija+kaṇṭha+samudbhavām

items.question: What is the source and nature of the stream Chinnamastā drinks?
premises: Chinnamastā is depicted drinking a stream.
The stream is described as bloody.
The stream arises from her own throat.
items.inference: Chinnamastā drinks a bloody stream that issues from her own severed throat.
items.plain_english: She is drinking the bloody stream that flows forth from her own throat.
